budget_rule: max(300, ceil(2*maximum pilot wall seconds /60)*60); checkpoints15,30,60,120,240,max. Determined from pilot duration only, never training quality.
selection_rule: Minimum predicted training microseconds among completed feasible candidates; ties broken by config_hash.
timing: CLOCK_BOOTTIME elapsed from Linux process start tick; includes imports, initialization, candidate generation/dedup/sort, model construction, analysis, profile queries/measurements, selection and per-run bookkeeping. Communication calibration and later training excluded.
deadline_rule: Finish/selection timestamp must be <= checkpoint. In-flight candidate may finish after maximum; retained in raw log but excluded.
caches: Each arm new process and empty operator cache; profile_seed_from_existing=False. Full/No-Inc reuse only same-run measurements. Shared premeasured communication calibration only.
incremental_behavior: Native structural and memory-template caches; native numeric event/schedule caches usable only when profiles are reusable. Profile-off invalidates numeric caches to force actual measurement while retaining structural/memory incremental reuse.
search_profile_gpu: physical GPU1; analytic target is world_size8; eight GPU Megatron training validation
training: Only timepoint winners deduplicated across all arms and budgets. Reuse exact Megatron evidence or one10-step run; maxrank synchronized step then meansteps6–10; throughput256/mean. OOM/failure retained, no fallback winner.

space.sp_rule: sp_degree=tp; sequence_parallel enabled when TP>1 in training
legal_rules: VPP:pp>1; layers divisible by pp*vpp; at least two virtual stages;chunks divisible by pp
space.order: sort SHA256 of 20261012:config_hash, independent of measured or predicted performance
